source.title: How Do LLMs Perform Two-Hop Reasoning in Context?
source.authors: Tian-Yu Guo; Han-Lin Zhu; Rui-Qi Zhang; Jian-Tao Jiao; Song Mei; Michael I. Jordan; Stuart Russell

record.file_problem: none; the full paper text is present.
record.tranche_reason: The paper studies a phase transition in two-hop reasoning, but it does not test grokking as defined here: it does not report training accuracy saturating while test accuracy remains at chance, later generalization after overfitting, or how delay varies with training-set size. Its brief mention of grokking is in related work.
record.gate_note: The paper reports a transition from near-uniform guessing to structured two-hop reasoning in a small Transformer. This is a related learning phenomenon, not a measurement of the overfitting-to-generalization behavior in the claim. LLM results compare answer probabilities across distractor counts before and after fine-tuning, not delayed generalization during training; omitted.
record.test_reason: Grokking is cited only in related work (Nanda et al. 2023). The study's results concern a sharp phase transition in training loss and predicted probabilities on an in-context two-hop task. It reports no train/test gap, no generalization delayed after training accuracy saturates, no dataset-size, weight-decay or initialization sweep, and no check of optimizer artifacts. The LLM part compares base and LoRA fine-tuned models across distractor counts, not generalization over the course of training.
record.authors_conclusion: Mostly correct. Pretrained LLMs (Llama2-7B, Qwen2.5-7B, Llama3.1-8B, OLMo-7B) guess roughly uniformly among end entities when distractors are present. Brief LoRA fine-tuning on one-distractor data yields near-perfect accuracy that generalizes to more distractors; OLMo generalizes less well. A three-layer Transformer shows a sharp phase transition from random guessing to a sequential-query mechanism, and a three-parameter model captures the abrupt transition.
record.recipe_differences: The paper studies in-context two-hop reasoning with distractors, not the grokking training setup in the claim.

fits_no_version.finding: A three-layer Transformer on symbolic two-hop reasoning with four distractors gives near-uniform (about 0.2) probabilities over end tokens until about step 800. It then abruptly shifts to a sequential-query mechanism. A three-parameter model reproduces the abrupt drop but not the slow phase.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: On in-context two-hop reasoning, a small Transformer's abrupt loss drop is driven by formation of a sequential-query attention circuit, preceded by a random-guessing plateau.

record.problems: The paper does not measure the train/test accuracy gap or overfitting interval needed to evaluate the claim. Its Transformer training dynamics are primarily shown in figures, and the reported results do not vary training-set size.
record.rows_left_out: The LLM tables report answer probabilities before and after fine-tuning across distractor counts, but do not measure delayed generalization during training and are not included.

untested.parts: No train-versus-test accuracy, no overfitting interval, no training-set-size sweep. The transition is in training loss on freshly sampled symbolic contexts.

Mechanism formation is traced through attention logits at steps 800 and 10000 and in a three-parameter model. No grokking generalizing circuit, no removal of memorizing components, and no progress measures anticipating a test-accuracy jump.
No non-algorithmic grokking setting and no initialization-scale or weight-norm manipulation.
LLM fine-tuning is a before/after comparison only, with no delayed-generalization trajectory over training.
Weight decay is fixed at 0.01. No efficiency account, critical dataset size or ungrokking.
Seeds are said to be consistent, but there is no comparison of algorithms across architectures or hyperparameters for a grokking task.
No test of optimizer or floating-point artifacts.

record.verdict_notes: The record's classification and rows are accurate; no row fixes are needed. The 'phase transition' here is an abrupt drop in training loss after a plateau, not generalization delayed after memorization. It should not be read as grokking evidence.

versions.untested_parts: No train-versus-test accuracy comparison, overfitting interval, or training-set-size sweep.

The paper analyzes a sequential-query mechanism, but does not test gradual formation of a grokking generalization circuit, later removal of memorizing components, or progress measures anticipating a generalization jump.
No non-algorithmic data or initialization-scale or weight-norm sweep.
No LLM pretraining or fine-tuning study of delayed generalization over training.
No test of weight decay or low-norm bias as an efficiency account, critical dataset size, or ungrokking.
No comparison of whether separate runs converge to the same algorithm across architectures or hyperparameters.
No test of optimizer or numerical artifacts as an explanation for grokking.

rows.subject: three-layer Transformer
rows.size_stated: 3 layers; a single attention head per layer
rows.operation_detail: Trained on the symbolic two-hop reasoning task with distractors.
rows.measure: Predicted probabilities for target and non-target end tokens
rows.value: The model assigns nearly uniform probabilities, around 0.2, to all possible end tokens.
rows.note: The text describes this stage as almost random guessing. This finding is recorded as a related training-dynamics result, not as evidence of grokking.

rows.subject: three-layer Transformer
rows.size_stated: 3 layers; a single attention head per layer
rows.operation_detail: Continued training on the symbolic two-hop reasoning task with distractors.
rows.measure: Attention-logit pattern associated with two-hop reasoning
rows.value: The query attends primarily to the target bridge token in layer 2 and the target end token in layer 3; the paper says this enables correct next-token prediction.
rows.note: The paper describes the structured attention pattern in the text. It does not report train-versus-test accuracy or overfitting at this stage.

source_check.scope: Only the listed rows, labels and statements were checked; presence is not whole-study approval.
